subject: dispatch_async

observation.summary: _dispatch_async is defined in __TEXT,__text of the arm64e slice at offset 0x00008827; the public C name dispatch_async resolves to this symbol via the standard Apple leading-underscore rename, confirmed by the symbol appearing in the undefined-symbol list of consumer test builds.

claim: dispatch_async is exported by libdispatch (macOS 27 / arm64e) as a defined global text symbol _dispatch_async at offset 0x8827, with the public macro-free name dispatch_async resolving through Apple's standard leading-underscore rename when a C source file references the SDK prototype.
